2026-10-27 (SCAN-1129 thread): second slice. New kit helpers chipClasses (components/ui/chip.tsx, the kit .chip/.chip.on) and choiceTileClasses (components/ui/choice-tile.tsx). Selected-state toggles (creator tabs, Near me, mobile editor tabs, billing toggle, visibility, practice builder, spaces toolbar), selectable tiles (event draft, RSVP, on-air, connection prefs, email opt-in, member viewer) and soft/ghost/state-driven actions (publish buttons, claim and join buttons, store, complete) moved onto the kit. Left: admin files, global-error, the Airwaves play button, circle-location-search (its probe mocks module deps), and quirk hits where the ratchet's proximity window catches a comment.

2026-10-26 bounded admin-route batch: 21 standard actions across14route components now use shared buttonClasses primary/secondary variants and kit sizing. Includes AI autonomy controls, review/recommendation actions, crew task creation, event settings, onboarding/elements/reward saves, CRM today actions, and Library Create/Sequence/Loom actions. Publish/Unpublish keeps its state-dependent primary/secondary styling. Explicit DOM types, action handlers, labels, disabled/pending guards and full-width/reduced-motion extras are preserved; nonclass AST equivalence is checked. Custom pressed filters, engine/style selectors, toggle chips and icon-only controls remain purpose-specific. No application state or provider mutation. Full visual acceptance remains separate; this is partial SCAN-1133 adoption.

2026-10-26 instrumentation correction: the former lexical <30 source probe now passes with genuine partial adoption, yet full-area kit/radius/eyebrow and rendered control criteria remain unproved. Split the evidence honestly: HYG-188 retains that exact counter and threshold as an automated regression budget, with actual29/30 CLI controls; this row stays OPEN/manual for full adoption and rendered acceptance. No counter, guard or budget was weakened.

verify.evidence: OPEN: owner sweeps and the21-action admin batch bring the unchanged raw-primary source counter below30, but that lexical budget does not prove full standard-action adoption, correct purpose-specific custom controls, shared radii/eyebrows or rendered accessibility across admin, Journey, events, Spaces and on-air. Preserve full-area rendered/control review before closure. HYG-188 separately keeps the exact original <30 command active as a narrow regression budget; no threshold changed.
